paragraphs.source_en: ‘‘Company culture’’ refers to many things, including how purchasing decisions are made; how the employees feel about the company; what the relationships are between different departments or between headquarters and its subsidiaries; the relationships your contact has with others on her team, with her boss, and with all of the other departments in the company; and how changes are proposed and implemented.
